Stage 01 • Physical Plant
Unloaded 3Ø Squirrel-Cage Motor

Free-spinning rotor shaft at 1500 RPM sync speed (50 Hz) with zero external mechanical load attached.

Stage 02 • Moulded Sensor Array
Vibration, CT Current, PT Voltage & RTD

Surface-mounted MEMS accelerometer on stator frame, non-invasive SCT-013 current clamp, and ZMPT101B voltage sensor.

Stage 03 • Edge Acquisition
ESP32 Dual-Core Telemetry MCU

Samples 12-bit ADC & I2C buses at 1 kHz, computes RMS envelopes, and drives the relay contactor interlock.

Stage 04 • Dual HMI Endpoints
Modbus TCP :502 & WebSockets

Streams holding registers (40001–40006) and low-latency JSON frames to the SCADA station and mobile app.
